mapper.sql: select r.id, o.id as object_id, r.study_instance_uid, r.series_instance_uid, r.sop_instance_uid, r.orthanc_instance_id, r.pixel_data_sha256, r.metadata_sha256, r.file_sha256, r.signed_content, r.signature_algorithm, r.signature_value, r.public_key_id, r.import_user_id, r.import_time, r.last_verify_time, r.verify_status, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time from ndt_dicom_integrity_record r left join ndt_dicom_object o on o.sop_instance_uid = r.sop_instance_uid and o.del_flag = '0' left join ndt_dicom_series ds on ds.id = o.series_id and ds.del_flag = '0' left join ndt_inspection_position p on p.id = ds.position_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join ndt_workpiece w on w.id = p.workpiece_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
and r.study_instance_uid like concat('%', #{studyInstanceUid}, '%') and r.series_instance_uid like concat('%', #{seriesInstanceUid}, '%') and r.sop_instance_uid like concat('%', #{sopInstanceUid}, '%') and r.orthanc_instance_id = #{orthancInstanceId} and r.verify_status = #{verifyStatus}
and exists(select 1 from ndt_inspection_task ct join ndt_customer cc on cc.id=ct.customer_id and cc.del_flag='0' where ct.id=w.task_id and ct.customer_id=#{params.scopeCustomerId} and ct.del_flag='0')
and exists ( select 1 from ndt_task_user tu where tu.task_id = w.task_id and tu.user_id = #{params.scopeUserId} and tu.can_view = '1' )
and 1 = 0
order by r.import_time desc, r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ndt_dicom_integrity_record (study_instance_uid, series_instance_uid, sop_instance_uid, orthanc_instance_id, pixel_data_sha256, metadata_sha256, file_sha256, signed_content, signature_algorithm, signature_value, public_key_id, import_user_id, import_time, last_verify_time, verify_status, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{studyInstanceUid}, #{seriesInstanceUid}, #{sopInstanceUid}, #{orthancInstanceId}, #{pixelDataSha256}, #{metadataSha256}, #{fileSha256}, #{signedContent}, #{signatureAlgorithm}, #{signatureValue}, #{publicKeyId}, #{importUserId}, #{importTime}, #{lastVerifyTime}, #{verifyStatus}, #{remark}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update ndt_dicom_integrity_record set study_instance_uid = #{studyInstanceUid}, series_instance_uid = #{seriesInstanceUid}, sop_instance_uid = #{sopInstanceUid}, orthanc_instance_id = #{orthancInstanceId}, pixel_data_sha256 = #{pixelDataSha256}, metadata_sha256 = #{metadataSha256}, file_sha256 = #{fileSha256}, signed_content = #{signedContent}, signature_algorithm = #{signatureAlgorithm}, signature_value = #{signatureValue}, public_key_id = #{publicKeyId}, import_user_id = #{importUserId}, import_time = #{importTime}, last_verify_time = #{lastVerifyTime}, verify_status = #{verifyStatus}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
